koreaderImport.preview.title: Confirm reading position
koreaderImport.preview.subtitle: Local: {title}
koreaderImport.target.label: Position after import
koreaderImport.preview.same: This device already has this position; nothing to import.
koreaderImport.preview.replaceHint: Confirming replaces this device's progress with the KOReader position.

koreaderImport.block.no-progress: This KOReader record has no reading position to import.
koreaderImport.block.chapter-missing: The local book does not have the chapter KOReader recorded, so it cannot be imported.
koreaderImport.block.offset-out-of-range: The position is past the text of this chapter in the local book, so it cannot be imported.
koreaderImport.block.dom-version-unsuppo: This record comes from a KOReader layout version that is not supported yet, so it cannot be imported exactly.
koreaderImport.block.whitespace-unverifi: KOReader's whitespace handling here cannot be confirmed, so it cannot be imported exactly.
koreaderImport.block.unsupported-positio: This kind of position record is not supported yet.
koreaderImport.working.previewing: Checking the position in the local book…
koreaderImport.block.node-missing: The position KOReader recorded is not in this chapter of the local book; it may be a different edition, so it cannot be imported.
koreaderImport.entry.detail: Pick one book's metadata.epub.lua and import its reading position
koreaderImport.picker.title: Choose a KOReader record (metadata.epub.lua)
koreaderImport.done: Imported the KOReader reading position for {title}
koreaderImport.done.unchanged: {title} already has this reading position; nothing changed
koreaderImport.error.invalid: The KOReader record cannot be read or is damaged. Nothing was written
koreaderImport.error.tooLarge: The KOReader record is too large. Nothing was written
koreaderImport.error.changed: The local book or the record changed after the preview. Nothing was written; import again
koreaderImport.error.readerBusy: This book is open for reading. Close its reader tab, then import again
koreaderImport.error.unbound: The original file of this book is not on this device, so it cannot be imported
koreaderImport.error.pendingProgress: This book has reading progress waiting to be saved. Open it and let it save, then import again
koreaderImport.error.closed: The import ended (shelf switched, locked or cancelled). Nothing was written
koreaderImport.error.busy: Another import or shelf task is running. Try again later
koreaderImport.error.randomAccess: This file cannot be read in place. Copy it to this device first, then import from there
koreaderImport.block.local-conflict: This book has conflicting reading progress here. Open the book and choose one first, then import.
